# m68k, GNU syntax, against `m68k-elf-as` (which assumes a 68020).
#
# Registers need the `%` sigil here: without it `d0` is a symbol. Comments
# start with `|`, and `#` is the immediate prefix.
#
# Left out on purpose, because rsasm and GNU as legitimately differ:
#   - GNU as substitutes instructions: `movel #1,%d0` becomes `moveq`,
#     `addw #1,%d0` becomes `addq`, and `cmp`/`and`/`or #imm,%dn` become the
#     `I` forms. rsasm assembles what is written.
#   - `label` as an absolute address, which GNU as turns into a PC-relative
#     reference when the label is in the same section.

# ---- the Amiga DMACON idiom ----
movew #0x7fff,0xdff096
movw #0x7fff,0xDFF096
move.w #0x7fff,0xdff096

# ---- register spellings and sizes ----
movew %d0,%d1
move.w %d0,%d1
movw %d0,%d1
movl %d0,%d1
moveb %d0,%d1
move %d0,%d1
movb %d0,%d1
movew %sp@,%d0
movew %fp@,%d0
movew %a6@,%d0
movew %a7@,%d0
movel %d0,%a1
movew %d0,%a1
moveal %d0,%a1
movea %d0,%a1
movew #1,%d0 | a comment
movew #1+2*3,%d0
movew #-1,%d0
movew #0xffff,%d0
moveb #0xff,%d0
moveb #-128,%d0
movew #'A',%d0
movel #0x12345678,%d7

# ---- MIT addressing modes ----
movew %d0,%a0@
movew %d0,%a0@+
movew %d0,%a0@-
movew %d0,%a0@(8)
movew %d0,%a0@(-8)
movew %d0,%a0@(8,%d1:w)
movew %d0,%a0@(8,%d1:l)
movew %d0,%a0@(8,%d1:w:4)
movew %d0,%a0@(8,%d1:l:4)
movew %d0,%a0@(%d1:w)
movew %d0,%a1@(0,%a2:l)
movew %a0@(8),%d0
movew %a0@+,%d0
movew %a0@-,%d0
movew %pc@(8),%d0
movew %pc@(8,%d0:w),%d0

# ---- Motorola addressing modes, which GNU as also takes ----
movew %d0,(%a0)
movew %d0,(%a0)+
movew %d0,-(%a0)
movew %d0,8(%a0,%d1.w)
movew %d0,8(%a0,%d1)
movew %d0,(8,%a0,%d1.l*4)
movew %d0,(%d1.w,%a0)
movew %d0,(%a0,%d1.w)
movew %d0,(%a1,%a2.l)
movew 8(%pc),%d0
movew %d0,-(%sp)
movel %sp@+,%d0

# ---- absolute addresses ----
movew %d0,0x400
movew %d0,0x400:w
movew %d0,(0x400).w
movew %d0,(0x400).l
movew %d0,0x400:l
movew %d0,0x8000
movew %d0,0xffff8000
movew %d0,-2
movel 0x12345678,%d0

# ---- MOVEQ, MOVEM, MOVEC, special registers ----
moveq #1,%d0
moveql #-128,%d0
moveq #127,%d7
moveml %d0-%d3/%a0-%a2,%sp@-
moveml %d0-%d3/%a0-%a2,-(%sp)
movem.l %d0-%d3/%a0-%a2,%sp@-
moveml %sp@+,%d0-%d3/%a0-%a2
moveml #0x3,%a0@
movemw %d0/%d2,%a0@
moveml %a0@(8),%d0-%a6
movel %usp,%a0
movel %a0,%usp
movew %sr,%d0
movew %d0,%ccr
movew %d0,%sr
movew #0x2700,%sr
movew %ccr,%d0
movec %d0,%vbr
movecl %vbr,%a0

# ---- LEA, PEA, EXG, SWAP, CLR, EXT ----
leal %a0@,%a1
lea %a0@(4),%a1
lea %a0@(0),%a1
pea %a0@
peal %a0@(-4)
exg %d0,%d1
exg %a0,%a1
exg %a1,%d0
swap %d0
swapw %d0
clrb %d0
clrw %d0
clrl %a0@
clr %d0
extw %d0
extl %d0
extbl %d0

# ---- arithmetic ----
addw %d0,%d1
addl %d0,%a1
addal %d0,%a1
addaw %d0,%a1
addib #1,%d0
addiw #1,%a0@
addil #0x10000,%a0@(4)
addqw #1,%d0
addqb #1,%d0
addq #8,%a0@+
addql #1,%a7
addxb %d0,%d1
addxl %a0@-,%a1@-
addxl -(%a0),-(%a1)
subw %d0,%d1
subl %a0@+,%d1
subw %d1,%a0@
subqw #1,%d0
subil #1,%d0
subxw %d0,%d1
subaw %a0@,%a0
cmpw %d0,%d1
cmpb %a0@,%d0
cmpal %a0,%a1
cmpl %a0,%d1
cmpmb %a0@+,%a1@+
cmpib #1,%d0
cmpiw #1,%a0@
andw %d0,%d1
andiw #1,%d0
andw %d0,%a0@
orl %d0,%d1
oriw #1,%d0
orb #1,%a0@
eorw %d0,%d1
eoriw #1,%d0
eorl #1,%d0
notw %d0
negl %d0
negxb %d0
abcd %d0,%d1
sbcd %a0@-,%a1@-
nbcd %a0@
muls %d0,%d1
mulsw %d0,%d1
mulul %d0,%d1
mulsl %d0,%d2:%d1
divu %d0,%d1
divuw %d0,%d1
divul %d0,%d1
divsl %d0,%d1
divsl %d0,%d2:%d1
divsll %d0,%d2:%d1
tstw %d0
tstl %a0
tstb %a0@(1)
tas %d0
tasb %d0
chkw %d0,%d1
chkl %d0,%d1
chk %d0,%d1

# ---- shifts and bits ----
aslw #1,%d0
lsll %d1,%d0
lsrw %a0@
rolb #1,%d0
roxrw %d0,%d1
lsl #1,%d0
asrl #8,%d7
rorw %a0@(2)
btst #3,%d0
btstb #3,%a0@
btstl #3,%d0
bset %d1,%d0
bclr #1,%a0@
bchg %d0,%a0@
bset #31,%d7

# ---- Scc, jumps, traps ----
seq %d0
seqb %d0
st %d0
sf %d0
scc %d0
sne %a0@
jmp %a0@
jmp %a0@(4)
jmp 0x400:w
jsr %a6@(-198)
jsr -198(%a6)
jsr 0x12345678
rts
rte
rtr
rtd #4
trap #15
trapv
link %a6,#-4
linkw %a6,#-4
linkl %a6,#-4
unlk %a6
nop
reset
stop #0x2700
illegal
bkpt #1
andiw #0xf8ff,%sr
andi #0xf8ff,%sr
andib #0xfe,%ccr
andi #0xfe,%ccr
oriw #0x700,%sr
eorib #1,%ccr

# ---- 68020 ----
cmp2l %a0@,%d0
chk2w %a0@,%d0
bfextu %d0{#1:#8},%d1
bftst %a0@{%d1:%d2}
bfins %d1,%a0@{#0:#32}
bfset %a0@(4){#3:#5}
movew %d0,%a0@(8:w,%d1:w)
movew %d0,%a0@(0x10000,%d1:w)
movew %d0,%a0@(8)@(4)
movew %d0,([8,%a0],%d1.w,4)
movew %d0,([8,%a0,%d1.w],4)
movew %d0,(8,%d1.w)
movew (%d1),%d0
movew %d0,(%d1.w*2)
movew %a0@(0x12345),%d0

# ---- the 68881, the 68851 and the rest of the 68020 set ----
# (every form of GNU's table is also in m68k-020.txt and its siblings;
# these are the readable spellings.) GNU as writes extended and packed
# float immediates differently from vasm and rsasm, so only single and
# double ones are here; see m68k-vasm-020.txt.
fmove.x	%fp0,%fp1
fmove.x	%fp7,%fp0
fadd.x	%fp1,%fp2
fsub.x	%fp3,%fp4
fmul.x	%fp5,%fp6
fdiv.x	%fp7,%fp0
fsqrt.x	%fp0,%fp1
fabs.x	%fp2
fneg.x	%fp3,%fp3
fmove.l	%d0,%fp0
fmove.w	%d1,%fp2
fmove.b	%d2,%fp3
fmove.l	%fp0,%d0
fmove.w	%fp1,%d1
fmove.b	%fp2,%d2
fmove.x	(%a0),%fp0
fmove.x	%fp0,(%a0)
fmove.x	(%a0)+,%fp1
fmove.x	%fp1,-(%a7)
fmove.d	0x10(%a0),%fp2
fmove.s	%fp3,0x20(%a1)
fmove.x	4(%a0,%d0.w),%fp4
fmove.x	4(%a0,%d0.l*4),%fp5
fmove.l	#1,%fp0
fmove.w	#0x1234,%fp0
fmove.b	#0x12,%fp0
fmove.l	%fpcr,%d0
fmove.l	%d0,%fpcr
fmove.l	%fpsr,(%a0)
fmove.l	%fpiar,%d1
fmovem.x	%fp0-%fp3,-(%a7)
fmovem.x	(%a7)+,%fp0-%fp3
fmovem.x	%fp0/%fp2/%fp4,(%a0)
fmovem.x	(%a0),%fp1/%fp3
fmovem.l	%fpcr/%fpsr,-(%a7)
fmovem.l	(%a7)+,%fpcr/%fpsr
fmovem.l	%fpcr/%fpsr/%fpiar,(%a0)
fmovecr	#0x32,%fp0
fmovecr	#0,%fp1
fsincos.x	%fp0,%fp1:%fp2
fsincos.x	(%a0),%fp3:%fp4
ftst.x	%fp0
ftst.l	%d0
ftst.x	(%a0)
fint.x	%fp0,%fp1
fintrz.x	%fp2
fetox.x	%fp0,%fp1
flogn.x	%fp2,%fp3
fsin.x	%fp0

fnop

frestore	(%a7)+

fmove.p	%fp0,(%a0){#5}
fmove.p	%fp1,(%a1){%d2}
pmove	%tc,(%a0)

pmove	%srp,-(%a7)

cas.w	%d2,%d3,(%a1)
cas.l	%d4,%d5,(%a2)
cas2.w	%d0:%d1,%d2:%d3,(%a0):(%a1)
cas2.l	%d0:%d1,%d2:%d3,(%a0):(%a1)
callm	#0,(%a0)
rtm	%d0
pack	%d0,%d1,#0

trapeq

traphi.l	#0x12345678
